summary: Underneath it, a fast, restless mind and an intensity you can't fake and a pull toward control work together when you choose to use them. The opening is there: you think and talk your way through anything, you go deep and survive what would flatten other people. It rewards you when you reach for it.
body: Underneath it, a fast, restless mind and an intensity you can't fake and a pull toward control work together when you choose to use them. The opening is there: you think and talk your way through anything, you go deep and survive what would flatten other people. It rewards you when you reach for it. Sales, persuasion, research, and anything requiring depth and force of message. Your mind may be drawn toward what sits beneath the surface. Conversation can become a way to understand motives, power, and hidden emotional truth.
gift: At your best: you think and talk your way through anything, and you go deep and survive what would flatten other people.
shadow: The trap: you overthink it, or talk when you should feel - or you grip too hard, test people, or burn it down before it can leave you.
integration: Let thinking and speech and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Sales, persuasion, research, and anything requiring depth and force of message.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you think and you go deep work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
